sources.snippet: Overview wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53 is a multilingual speech representation model from facebook pretrained on raw audio waveforms across 53 languages using a self-supervised contrastive learning approach. The model operates on 16kHz sampled audio and must be fine-tuned on downstream tasks like automatic speech recognition rather than used directly for inference. Built on the wav2vec 2.0 ...

sources.snippet: XLS-R is a set of large-scale models for self-supervised cross-lingual speech representation learning based on wav2vec 2.0. It was pretrained on 128 languages and approximately 436K hours of unlabeled speech data.
